small changes

issues.title: fix: APPLICATION_MODAL type doesn't exist upon the discord-interactions
issues.body: As of https://github.com/discord/discord-interactions-js/blob/main/src/index.ts the type should be MODAL, not APPLICATION_MODAL. Discovered from https://github.com/discord/discord-example-app/issues/21

issues.title: Update command registration
issues.body:
- Update command registration to use `npm run register` instead of just checking for commands every time server is started
- Change to use bulk overwrite method and global commands (they don't have the same propagation times anymore)
- Update docs
- Update `app.js` to be template for tutorial, move full `app.js` into `examples/app.js`

issues.title: Examples : InteractionResponseType.MODAL instead of InterationResponseType.APPLICATION_MODAL
issues.body:
I was struggling using modal interactions and getting "Interaction failed" errors.

Exemple here does not match correct response type : 
https://github.com/discord/discord-example-app/blob/main/examples/modal.js#L25

Solved when using `InteractionResponseType.MODAL`

issues.title: Getting "Bad request signature" error while setting up interations endpoint URL
issues.body: After running the example and running local server with **ngrok** . I set the URL in discord settings according to the doc but after that I am getting **Bad request signature** error. It's coming from the utils.js file `VerifyDiscordRequest` function. How can we resolve this issue ?

pullRequests.title: Actually await HasGuildCommand
pullRequests.body:
We've got these two async functions, but they are just being called in a `forEach()`.

Since these commands are parallelizable, we should await them with a `Promise.all()`.
